items.stem: What is the main benefit of grounding a Gemini response in your own Drive documents?

options.text: Answers draw on your specific content rather than only general knowledge
options.rationale: Correct: grounding ties the response to your documents.

options.text: It guarantees the answer is always factually correct
options.rationale: Grounding improves relevance but does not guarantee correctness.

options.text: It makes the model train on your data permanently
options.rationale: Grounding is retrieval at answer time, not training.

options.text: It removes the need to review the output
options.rationale: Review is still required regardless of grounding.

items.explanation: Correct: grounding makes answers draw on your own content.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which element most improves a prompt's reliability for a specific task?

options.text: Clear task, context and desired output format
options.rationale: Correct: structure and context make outputs more reliable.

options.text: Maximum possible length regardless of relevance
options.rationale: Length alone does not improve reliability.
Capitalisation does not meaningfully change reliability.

options.text: Removing all context to keep it short

items.explanation: Correct: clear task, context and format improve reliability.

items.stem: Which TWO are good responsible-use practices when using Gemini for work? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Verify facts and figures before acting on them
Avoid pasting data you are not permitted to share
options.rationale: Correct: respect confidentiality and data-handling rules.

options.text: Assume every output is confidential automatically
options.rationale: Confidentiality depends on context and settings, not assumption.

options.text: Skip human review for customer-facing messages

items.explanation: Correct: verify outputs and respect data-sharing rules.
